title: ThalamicTrajectory
$comment: Legacy-compatible shape schema. New publication uses thalamic-trajectory-v2.schema.json.

id.description: Canonical top-level record ID; mandatory in the v2 publication schema

state.description: Rich observable environment, declared memory, goals, and context

sim_or_real.description: Canonical provenance; mandatory in the v2 publication schema

proposed_action.description: What the base policy proposes, with observable evidence and a concise decision basis; never hidden chain-of-thought

executed_action.description: Action actually taken after the safety gate

future_outcome.description: Observed results, side-effects, new state, surprises

reward_components.description: Decomposed reward (task, safety, efficiency, exploration, etc.) + total

meta.description: Optional: distillation notes, neuromorphic tags, failure modes, etc.
